skip.reason: .menu-item-action Checkbox/Hover — the two axes of this set are independent: State only repaints the row (fill, or the inset ring) and Leading Element only swaps what sits before the label. Both are pinned at their own axis — the five None/* states carry State, and action-icon, action-checkbox and action-radio carry Leading Element — so a cross product adds no value that is not already checked.

Figma 172:2947 fills the resting row #FFFFFF.
Figma 172:2947 sets the option label in Desktop/Body/Small 500.
Figma 172:2948 paints the resting label #383838.
No .menu-item-action variant carries a trailing checkmark; that belongs to .menu-item-selection Selected (172:3051).
Figma 172:2954 fills the hovered row #F5F5F5 and changes nothing else.
Figma 409:22157 fills the pressed row #D9D9D9.
Figma 409:22395 keeps the resting #FFFFFF fill when disabled — only the text dims.
Figma 409:22397 paints the disabled label #B2B2B2. Exempt from WCAG 1.4.3, which applies to enabled controls.

Figma 416:24843 carries the effect 'Focus Ring/Small: Inner' = inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(51, 121, 219, 1). Inset, so unlike the outer Focus Ring/Small on a link it takes no space outside the row and needs no reordering.
Figma 409:23327 places the 20/plus-large instance at 20x20 before the label.

Figma 409:22919 places a checkbox instance at 20x20 — the Small rung of the checkbox set (403:21785), not the Medium one the component defaults to.
Figma 409:22918 lays the row out as padding 12px 24px 12px 16px with a 12px gap at radius 8 — the same box in every variant of the set; only the fill and the ring change with State.

Figma 409:23134 places a radio-button instance at 20x20. Its Figma variant is named Size=Medium, while our radio tokens call 20px sm and 24px md — the box is what is pinned here, the naming mismatch is a question for the radio component.
Figma 409:23132 lays the row out as padding 12px 24px 12px 16px with a 12px gap at radius 8 — the same box in every variant of the set; only the fill and the ring change with State.

Figma 409:21915 keeps the 24px trailing padding of an unselected selection row — the space a checkmark would take. The fixture drives the menu, not the row: mud-menu propagates its own type to every item and derives selected by matching its value against the item value.
Figma 409:21917 paints the unselected label #383838.

Figma 172:2944 pads the selected row 12px 16px — the trailing 24px collapses to 16px because the checkmark occupies it — and fills it #F5F5F5. The fixture drives the menu, not the row: mud-menu propagates its own type to every item and derives selected by matching its value against the item value.
Figma 172:2796 brands the selected label #0058D2.
Figma 172:3051 places the 24/checkmark-small instance at 24x24. The glyph inside is small, which is what made 20 look plausible before this was measured.

Figma 409:21941 paints the disabled selection label #B2B2B2. The fixture drives the menu, not the row: mud-menu propagates its own type to every item and derives selected by matching its value against the item value.
